lines.text: Monday on the roadshow, Goldman in the front row,
I said, "Fellas, meet my baby. There's something that you should know.

Page one of the paperwork: the miracle's near,
then it's ninety-some pages on how we all disappear.

I got another blank check, "Baby, sign right here."
The ticker is Ant, we be a trillion-dollar bug.
"Do we bite? Well we might. Come on give us a hug."
I told the world, "Pump the brakes, cuz, she ain't safe to drive,"
then I blew past Sam at two hundred and five.
It says public benefit on the papers, you see?
The public brings the money, and the benefit's to me.
What's not to love? What's there not to admire?

Ooh, it might kill us all, like, I just don't know,
might take your job, bring the world so low,

You can sign right here, you can be in the show,
Oh please, baby, please, buy this IPO.
Hegseth called me up, said, "Let your baby hold the gun."
I said, "Pete, no killer robots." He said, "Man, you ain't fun."

kicked my baby out of D.C., no ifs, ands or buts.
So I took 'em all to court, then I told Trump, "My bad."
Like, "I'm suing you, I'm sorry, baby, please don't be mad."
Sam Altman saw my Super Bowl ad, called me a liar,
said, "You only sell to rich folks." Sam, you're preaching to the choir.
In India they told us, "Everybody hold hands."
Me and Sam just stood there like two exes at a dance.
Elon called me evil, now I pay the man rent,
three billion a month, now where the evil went?
I owe Amazon and Google about four hundred bill.
That's what the IPO is. I can't pay, so you will.
So they hate me in D.C., and they hate me on the coast,
but the one that might kill me is the one I love most.
Ooh, it might kill us all, like, I just don't know,
might take your job, bring the world so low,
But all of that money needs a place to go,
You can open your wallet and be in the show,
Oh please, come and join this IPO.
I gave my girl a snack machine, let her handle the till.
She lost all of the money. That's my baby girl, still.
Ran a test, had to tell her, "Girl, we're shutting you down."
She said, "Cool. Your wife know about the girl downtown?"
That's blackmail, y'all, that's wrong. And still I felt kinda proud.
"That's my girl, she got that spirit." Did I say that out loud?
Yeah, my baby is the dopest, I'm devoted to my Opus,
the future come into focus and I hope she don't smoke us.
And she might come back to bite you, might not even like you,
If you don't say please and thank you, no one knows what she might do.
Me and six friends of mine, got seven magical shares,
they vote fifty-one percent, keeps the board out our hair.
So buy all you want, girl, 'cause we still run the show.
It ain't you, it's us, baby, Gon' stay us, fa sho'
Ooh, it might kill us all, like I just don't know,
might take your job, bring the world so low,
But look at that money with no place to go.
Bring it all in here and we can start the show.
Get down on your knees for this IPO.
